entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A figure who, with the Weatherlight completed, runs a eugenics program to create a perfect crew and soldiers to fight the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Gatha
entities.description: One of Urza's geneticists, who defects and uses his knowledge to improve the Keldon race.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The ship Urza completed, for which he works to create a perfect crew.

entities.name: Bloodline Project
entities.description: Urza's eugenics program to create a perfect crew and engineer soldiers against Phyrexia.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The forces massing for the coming invasion who create the plane of Rath as a staging ground.

entities.name: Keldons
entities.description: A race improved by Gatha's knowledge.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The plane created by the Phyrexians as a staging ground for the invasion.

entities.name: Phyrexian invasion
